incident-bot: [PAGE] SLO alert: Redwood Dedicated - eu-west-1 - p99 latency breach (30m). Route: /v1/generate-stream. Current p99=2.4s (SLO=1.2s). Ticket: INC-7621

maria: paging oncall. seeing streaming stalls and long tails across a subset of dedicated hosts. tagging alex for infra.

alex: on it. initial look: queue depth on pool-dedicated-gpu-7 spiked to 580 (target 200) about 12:04 UTC, warmup failures on new nodes during autoscale.

sam: which customers impacted? any external 5xx?

maria: ~3 customers showing elevated client retries, no 5xx yet — mostly high token-latency and stalled SSEs. Support already notified for two enterprise tenants.

frank: adding quick telemetry: stack: serving-runtime v2.3.1, autoscaler v1.9, kernel-profiles stable. metrics snippet:
```
svc.dedicated.eu-west-1.pool-dedicated-gpu-7.queue_depth 580
svc.dedicated.eu-west-1.pool-dedicated-gpu-7.active_hosts 8
svc.dedicated.eu-west-1.pool-dedicated-gpu-7.pending_warmups 6
request.latency.p99 2400ms
streaming.stalls.count 37
```

maria: timeline: burst of traffic from a couple high-concurrency customers at ~12:00, autoscaler attempted +4 nodes but warmup timeouts (~60s) because init script blocked on model cache fetch. KV cache misses spiked.

alex: root cause hypothesis: cold-start model cache fetch throttled by external blobstore (rate-limit) -> model load slowed -> nodes stayed unhealthy for warmup healthchecks -> autoscaler backed off, queue accumulated -> tail latency.

sam: ok triage plan: 1) short-term mitigation: reduce max-pending requests per host, enable fallback routing to smaller-quantized model variant, and temporarily raise concurrency watermark to trigger faster prewarm. 2) mid-term: review blobstore client retries and parallelism for model pulls. 3) postmortem: adjust autoscaler warmup window and add warmup metrics.

maria: executing short-term now. @ops-bot can you set route fallback for eu-west-1 /v1/generate-stream -> model:rw-small-quantized-1 for tier=enterprise?

ops-bot: command accepted: apply-route-fallback --region eu-west-1 --route /v1/generate-stream --from model:rw-large@v123 --to model:rw-small-quant@v45 --scope tenant:enterprise

frank: also throttling requests from top offending API keys at the load-balancer level to reduce queue tail. sending ACL patch now.

alex: started manual prewarm on 4 hosts by preloading model artifacts in parallel and disabling healthcheck strictness for 30s. watch host health.

maria: monitoring p95/p99: p95 moved from 480ms -> 600ms, p99 trending down from 2.4s -> 1.1s after fallbacks/rate-limits. streaming stalls count decreasing.

sam: good. customer impact: two enterprise tenants had degraded streaming experience (latency spikes, some stalled streams). CS notified, mitigation in progress.

maria: we should capture sequences for failed streams for quality alerts. also attach eval prompt logs for affected tenants to seat regressions.

frank: note: autoscaler logs show warmup timeout errors 12:01:05 -> 12:02:20 with repeated model-pull 429 from blobstore. increasing blobstore client backoff didn't help, need upstream quota bump or more parallel endpoints.

alex: temporarily changed model pull concurrency to 2 -> 6 on the init image, that reduced REST 429s since we staggered requests.

ops-bot: routing fallback active. ACL rate-limits applied to keys: [key-tnr-001, key-tnr-009].

maria: p99 now at 980ms 12:15 UTC. still watching for secondary spikes.

sam: continuing monitoring. next steps for post-incident:
- add autoscaler metric for 'pending_warmups' and 'model_pull_429' alerting.
- improve prewarm strategy: keep warm spare capacity during business hours for heavy tenants.
- implement streaming fallback: when token emission stalls >2s fallback to chunked-batched path.
- review blobstore rate limits and add multi-region mirror for artifact pulls.

frank: I'll open infra ticket INF-3392 for blobstore quota & mirrors, include logs and sample model-pull traces.

alex: create change to autoscaler config to increase warmup timeout from 60s -> 120s for large-model pools and add exponential backoff jitter. I'll PR.

maria: thanks. oncall handoff: i need to drop in 20m. alex taking next watch. alex you have the lead?

alex: taking lead. maria heading OOO in 20. tagging pager.

ops-bot: incident-bot: REMINDER: file 'incident summary' with customer impact, timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups. template: /templates/incident-summary.md

maria: summary draft: "Dedicated pool 'gpu-7' hit rapid burst from high-concurrency tenants. Blobstore model pull 429s caused warmup failures and delayed autoscale leading to queue backlog and streaming tail latency. Immediate mitigations: route-level fallback to quantized model, ACL rate-limits, manual prewarm, staggered model pulls. Outcome: p99 returned within SLO after 15m; two tenants experienced degraded streaming. Follow-ups: INF-3392, PR-4571 (autoscaler warmup), and add alert 'pending_warmups>5 for 5m'."

sam: looks good. assign owners: INF-3392 -> frank, PR-4571 -> alex, alerts -> maria.

maria: closing page, leaving notes in incident tracker. last check 12:34 UTC p99=850ms p95=560ms. thanks team. :tada:

ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident INC-7621 transitioned to 'Mitigated' at 1769202567.
